entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex... I'm calling because I need to return something. It's a new helmet I bought a few weeks ago.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference matter?

Oh, it's not broken or anything. It's just... the color. It looked different online, and it just doesn't match my gear at all. I know it's silly, but I feel deflated just looking at it. The box is still unopened, I haven't even touched it.

I completely understand. It's important that you feel confident in your gear, especially for something as critical as safety equipment. Let me just pull up your order details. I see you received it 21 days ago.
Yes, that sounds right. I was just hoping... I mean, I've been a loyal customer for a long time, and I really needed this money back for some other expenses. I feel so bad about this.
There's no need to feel bad at all. Let me check our return policy for you... Okay, good news. Our policy allows for returns on standard items for up to 90 days, so you are well within that window.
Oh, really? Are you sure? That's such a relief.

Absolutely. Since the box is unopened, this is a very straightforward process. I'm emailing you a prepaid return label right now. Just attach that to the package and drop it off. Once our warehouse receives it, we'll issue a full refund.
Wow, thank you so much, Alex. You have no idea what a help that is. I really appreciate it.

It's my pleasure. And I see here that you're a VIP member with us. As a thank you for your loyalty, I've also added a $20 credit to your account. Hopefully, that can help you find a new helmet with the perfect color that makes you feel great and prioritizes your safety.
That is so kind of you! Thank you! I'll definitely be ordering the right one from you guys.
We'd be happy to help you with that. Is there anything else I can do for you today?
No, that's everything. You've been wonderful. Thanks again.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
